title: Marketing Action Plan
content:
Days 1–7

Pre-Market & Exclusive Marketing

Exclusive Pre-MLS MarketingUtilize private real estate groups, brokerage channels, and luxury home forums. Offer an exclusive first look to targeted investor groups and high-net-worth individuals.
Professional Photography & VideographyHigh-quality listing photos showcasing the property’s best features. Drone footage for expansive property visibility. Virtual tours providing immersive 3D experiences for remote buyers. Lifestyle videography to showcase the home’s unique appeal.
Day 7 onward

Public Listing & Online Exposure

MLS & Listing WebsitesList on MLS, Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, and other high-traffic platforms. Optimize listing descriptions with compelling storytelling and SEO-driven keywords.
Zillow Showcase ListingA special Zillow Showcase listing that gets additional exposure from Zillow because we are one of the top brokerages in the area.
Social Media MarketingInstagram & Facebook: reels, carousel posts, and strategically placed paid ads; engage with local real estate groups and community pages. YouTube & TikTok: video walkthroughs with storytelling and short teaser clips. LinkedIn & X: target professionals and investors while sharing market insights.
Email & Direct MarketingTargeted email blasts with personalized outreach to potential buyers and agents. Just-listed postcards sent to surrounding neighborhoods and past clients. Neighborhood flyers at high-traffic locations.
